title: Lazarus preservation release v1
description: The document binding a verified Lazarus fixture to a statement made about it. It records what verification established rather than what the fixture's manifest claims, because the manifest is the part a producer can edit.

fixture.description: Where the fixture sits inside the release, and the digest verification computed over it.

statement.description: The statement made about the fixture, digested as bytes. Lazarus does not write it and does not interpret its predicate beyond the fields the binding checks.

predicate_type.description: The type the statement declares. A URI, as in-toto predicate types are, so a release cannot name one that identifies nothing.

verified.description: What verification established, recomputed from the fixture's records. These are the numbers the binding holds a statement to.

canonical_chain_claim.description: Always false. A self-consistent header is not proof that it belongs to Ethereum's canonical chain, and no part of this release establishes that it does.

binding.description: Which checks the binding made. Named so a reader of the release knows what was established rather than inferring it from the release existing.

items.description: The name of one check the binding made. A name that renders as nothing reads as an entry and establishes none.
